description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Dion], [ATK +500 (25s) (Tactical)] to user.

description.name: Mode
description.text: Holy abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10,000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times, have zero hone cost, triggers [ATB_10%] after using Holy abilities while in Tactical Awoken Mode; removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text: One single attack (11.00 each) capped at 199,999, ranged. Grants [Holy Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Holy 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Rampage Mode: Dion] and Tactical Ether 2 if there are six or less remaining ability uses in [Tactical Awoken Mode], grants [Dualcast Holy (Tactical) 5] to the user if not

description.name: Holy Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap for Holy attacks by 20000, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Holy 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)
description.text: Grants [125% ATB 1] after using a Holy ability, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: 125% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x1.25

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Rampage Mode: Dion
description.text: Cast time x999999 for Holy abilities, triggers [Rampage: Dion] after using Holy abilities, removed after triggering three times

description.name: Rampage: Dion
description.text: Grants [200% ATB 1] to user, damages the user for 10% max HP

description.name: 200% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x2.00

description.name: Dualcast Holy (Tactical) 5
description.text: Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time, removed after triggering five times or if the user hasn't [Tacical Awoken Mode]
